replication.target_description: Relationship of activity timing and time scarcity with elicited wage rates under Time-Elicit (TEL; stating the maximum hours for a task) and Money-Elicit (MEL; stating the minimum money for a task) procedures; focus on the interaction between elicitation procedure and activity timing.

n.exclusions: 7 participants with responses three or more standard deviations beyond the mean excluded from 474 recruited.
